data.name: Survivors: Island Adventure
data.detailed_description:
After a plane crash, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious tropical island. With no clear way home, your journey turns into an unexpected adventure filled with secrets, discoveries and survival challenges!

Explore jungles, beaches, lagoons, ruins and mountains while completing quests and unlocking new areas. Restore and upgrade your camp, gather resources and follow a story that gradually reveals the island’s hidden past. Progress through the adventure by completing puzzle levels that drive the story forward and open new locations.

Can you survive, explore the island and uncover its secrets?

Key Features

• Exploration-Driven Adventure

Investigate diverse island locations packed with resources, hidden items and challenges.

• Camp Building & Crafting

Restore and upgrade your camp, craft tools and improve your ability to survive hostile environments.

• Resource Management & Cooking

Gather materials, grow crops, find wild ingredients and prepare meals to sustain the survivors.

• Quests, Inventory & Treasures

Complete structured quests, collect artifacts and caches and manage your inventory efficiently.

• Mystery & Survival Themes

Face environmental dangers and strange creatures while uncovering the truth behind the island.

• Match-3 Progression System

Complete hundreds of match-3 levels to unlock areas, clear obstacles, earn boosters and advance the story.

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.

You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10.0 build 16299, and higher
  • Processor: 1 GHz or faster with support for PAE, NX, and SSE2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Microsoft DirectX 11 graphics device with WDDM driver
  • Storage: 1800 MB available space
